t: Lesson 4 — Step 2: the dwell timer and the feeder
html:
In the app

Guided mode’s lesson 4 is this chapter: it checks that this lesson’s tags are made, that S2_Dwell exists, is called from MainRoutine and verifies, and then watches the line while you run it and ticks each result as it happens:

  • Start the line: Dwell.DN comes on after a second
  • A bottle drops at the head of the line

The line indexes: belt stops, sensors read, bottle dropped, belt steps. The dwell is the stop. Add JSR(S2_Dwell); to MainRoutine under step 1 and write the rung.

Tags this lesson needs

Create these before you type the rungs (Verify reports any you miss as unknown). Tags from earlier lessons are not repeated.

TagTypeKindDescription
Conv_IndexBOOLbase tagLatched while the belt steps one pitch
DwellTIMERbase tagBelt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle
Bottle_Feed_EmitBOOLalias of Local:4:O.Data.0Bottle_Feed Emit: one bottle per rising edge

The rungs

How it fits together

While the line runs and the belt is not stepping (Conv_Index, which step 3 will latch while the belt moves), the Dwell timer counts a second, and on the same rung the feeder’s Emit is energized; the feeder is in edge mode, so one bottle appears at the head of the line on the rising edge, once per stop. When the dwell is done, step 3 steps the belt and resets the timer for the next stop.

Why an RTO and not a TON? A TON resets the moment its rung goes false, and the rung goes false whenever the line stops. Press Stop half-way through a dwell, Start again, and a TON would time the whole second again; press Stop after the dwell was done and the registers (step 4, which shift when Dwell.DN comes on) would shift a second time for the same stop. The retentive timer keeps what it has: a stopped dwell resumes where it was, and a finished one stays done. An RTO only clears with RES, and that rung belongs to step 3, which moves the belt. The feeder does not drop a second bottle on Start either: an edge-mode feeder only drops when its exit is clear, and the bottle it dropped is still standing there.

Run it

Start the line. Exactly one bottle drops at the head of the belt and sits there, because nothing steps the belt yet; Dwell.DN comes on after a second and stays on. Watch Dwell.ACC count to 1000 and stop. That is correct for now: step 3 is next.

Try it

Change the preset to 3000, Start, and press Stop when the accumulator reads about 1500: it holds 1500. Start again and it carries on to 3000. Set it back to 1000. In the finished line the dwell is the one number that sets the line’s speed.

rungs.head: S2_Dwell · Rung 0
rungs.comment: BELT STOPPED: a 1 s dwell runs and the feeder output is held on. Bottle_Feed is in edge mode, so it drops exactly one bottle per rising edge, that is one per stop. RTO, not TON: if the line is stopped in the middle of a dwell the time already run is kept (and a finished dwell stays done), so Start carries on and the registers do not shift twice for one stop. A new bottle is not dropped either: the feeder only drops when its exit is clear

pred.q: Line_Run is on and Conv_Index is off. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is true: Dwell times toward its preset and Bottle_Feed_Emit is on.

rungs.words: When Line_Run (Seal-in run bit (LogixPro B3:0/0)) is on and Conv_Index (Latched while the belt steps one pitch) is off, the rung runs the retentive timer Dwell (Belt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle) toward 1000 ms (1 s) and turns Bottle_Feed_Emit (Bottle_Feed Emit: one bottle per rising edge) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Line_Run) Examine If Closed asks: true when Line_Run is on.
  2. XIO(Conv_Index) Examine If Open asks: true when Conv_Index is off.
  3. A branch of 2 parallel paths: each path is tested on its own and does its own work.
    Path 1
    1. RTO(Dwell,1000,0) Retentive Timer On does: runs the retentive timer Dwell toward 1000 ms (1 s). Like TON, but it keeps its time when the rung goes false; only a RES clears it.
    Path 2
    1. OTE(Bottle_Feed_Emit) Output Energize does: turns Bottle_Feed_Emit on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

pats.why: Dwell keeps its time when the rung goes false and carries on from there next time; only a RES clears it.
pats.think: a stopwatch: stop it and the time stays on the dial until you press reset.
pats.watch: Nothing clears an RTO but RES. Forget the RES and the second cycle starts already done.
